  • Classes in dev.relism.flash.ext.security.saml used by dev.relism.flash.ext.security.saml
    Class
    Description
    Saml
    SAML 2.0 for one app, as a service provider: Web Browser SSO into a Security session, and Single Logout both ways.
    SamlIdp
    A SAML identity provider the application trusts, known by its metadata: where to send users, the keys it signs with, how it logs out.
    SamlKeys
    The application's keys as a SAML service provider, each a PKCS#8 private key and its X.509 certificate in PEM.
    SamlModule
    SAML 2.0 for an app, as a service provider to any number of identity providers: sign-in that ends in a session, Single Logout both ways, and this application's metadata for providers to import.
    SamlPrincipal.NameId
    A saml:NameID with its qualifiers, null where absent.
